One concrete reporting inconsistency needs an explicit offline note: both candidates still contain cleanup_complete=false while cleanup_commands_complete/fini_unload_complete=true and strictpassed=true. observe.py initializes inheritedcleanup_complete=false atline67 but never updates it; status.py does not use that field. Please confirm this is an unused inherited reporting default, pin actual cleanup command/reply/slot/mode/heap witnesses and explain the misleading field in your separate final aggregate/addendum. Do not rewrite originalresult/raw or silently claim that false field wastrue. If underlyingcleanupwitness is missing, report it as realfailure.
